question: Part 5 中节点的符号名如何构成，实际 NodeId 由哪里定义？标准定义节点与服务器动态生成节点的 NamespaceIndex 有什么不同？

answer.answer:
在 Part 5 中，节点的符号名与 NodeId 的构成如下：

**符号名的构成**：本标准中描述的所有节点的 NodeId 只是符号名，实际 NodeId 由 OPC 10000-6 定义 [C1][C2]。每个节点的符号名是其 BrowseName；当该节点是另一个节点的一部分时，符号名为“另一节点的 BrowseName + '.' + 自身 BrowseName”。这里的“一部分”指整体对部分具有 HasProperty 或 HasComponent 引用。由于不属于其他节点的所有节点在本标准中具有唯一名称，符号名是唯一的。例如 ServerType 的符号名为 "ServerType"，其 InstanceDeclaration 可标识为 "ServerType.ServerCapabilities"，更深的为 "ServerType.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate"；基于 ServerType 的 Server 对象符号名为 "Server"，其实例符号名为 "Server.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate" [C1][C2]。

**实际 NodeId 的定义位置**：实际 NodeId 由 OPC 10000-6 定义 [C1][C2]。

**NamespaceIndex 的差异**：
- 本标准定义的所有 NodeId 的 NamespaceIndex 为 0，该 NamespaceIndex 对应的命名空间由 OPC 10000-3 规定 [C1][C2]。
- 本标准不仅定义具体节点，还要求生成某些节点（例如服务器上每个 Session 一个节点）。这些节点的 NodeId 是服务器特定的，包括命名空间；但其 NamespaceIndex 不能是 0，因为它们不是由 OPC Foundation 定义，而是由服务器生成 [C1][C2]。

此外，本标准定义的所有 BrowseNames 的 NamespaceIndex 也为 0 [C3][C4]。

retrieved.title: NodeIds
retrieved.snippet:
4.1 NodeIds

The NodeIds of all Nodes described in this standard are only symbolic names. OPC 10000-6 defines the actual NodeIds.

The symbolic name of each Node defined in this standard is its BrowseName, or, when it is part of another Node, the BrowseName of the other Node, a ".", and the BrowseName of itself. In this case "part of" means that the whole has a HasProperty or HasComponent Reference to its part. Since all Nodes not being part of another Node have a unique name in this standard, the symbolic name is unique. For example, the ServerType defined in 6.3.1 has the symbolic name "ServerType". One of its InstanceDeclarations would be identified as "ServerType.ServerCapabilities". Since this Object is complex, another InstanceDeclaration of the ServerType is "ServerType.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate". The Server Object defined in 8.3.2 is based on the ServerType and has the symbolic name "Server". Therefore, the instance based on the InstanceDeclaration described above has the symbolic name "Server.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate".

The NamespaceIndex for all NodeIds defined in this standard is 0. The namespace for this NamespaceIndex is specified in OPC 10000-3.

Note that this standard not only defines concrete Nodes, but also requires that some Nodes have to be generated, for example one for each Session running on the Server. The NodeIds of those Nodes are server-specific, including the Namespace. However the NamespaceIndex of those Nodes cannot be the NamespaceIndex 0, because they are not defined by the OPC Foundation but generated by the Server.

**符号名构成**
- 本标准中所有节点的 NodeId 只是符号名（symbolic names），实际 NodeId 由 OPC 10000-6 定义 [C1][C2][C4]。
- 每个节点的符号名就是它的 BrowseName；当该节点是另一个节点的一部分时，符号名为“另一节点的 BrowseName + "." + 自身 BrowseName”。这里的“part of”指整体对部分具有 HasProperty 或 HasComponent 引用 [C1][C2][C4]。
- 由于不属于其他节点的节点在本标准中都有唯一名称，符号名是唯一的 [C1][C2][C4]。

**实际 NodeId 由哪里定义**
- 实际 NodeId 由 OPC 10000-6 定义 [C1][C2][C4]。

**NamespaceIndex 的差异**
- 本标准定义的所有 NodeId 的 NamespaceIndex 为 0；该 NamespaceIndex 对应的命名空间由 OPC 10000-3 规定 [C1][C2][C4]。
- 对于标准要求服务器生成的节点（例如每个运行中的 Session 对应一个节点），其 NodeId 是服务器特定的，包括命名空间；但这些节点的 NamespaceIndex 不能是 0，因为它们不是由 OPC Foundation 定义、而是由服务器生成的 [C1][C2][C4]。

retrieved.title: §6.3.3 L443-L447
retrieved.snippet:
EnabledFlag identifies whether or not diagnostic information is collected by the Server. It can also be used by a client to enable or disable the collection of diagnostic information of the Server. The following settings of the Boolean value apply: TRUE indicates that the Server collects diagnostic information, and setting the value to TRUE leads to resetting and enabling the collection. FALSE indicates that no diagnostic information is collected, and setting the value to FALSE disables the collection without resetting the diagnostic values.

When diagnostics are turned off, the Server can return Bad_NodeIdUnknown for all static diagnostic Nodes except the EnabledFlag Property. Dynamic diagnostic Nodes (such as the Session Nodes) will not appear in the AddressSpace.

If the collection of diagnostic information is not supported, the EnabledFlag Property will be read only.
retrieved.label: [C5]

retrieved.title: §1 L9-L11
retrieved.snippet:
1 Scope

This part of the OPC Unified Architecture defines the Information Model .The Information Model describes standardised Nodes of a Server's AddressSpace. These Nodes are standardised types as well as standardised instances used for diagnostics or as entry points to server-specific Nodes. Thus, the Information Model defines the AddressSpace of an empty OPC UA Server. However, it is not expected that all Servers will provide all of these Nodes.
retrieved.label: [C6]

retrieved.title: §6.3.4 L466-L471
retrieved.snippet:
SessionDiagnosticsArray provides an array with an entry for each session in the Server having general diagnostic information about a session.


            SessionSecurityDiagnosticsArray provides an array with an entry for each active session in the Server having security-related diagnostic information about a session. Since this information is security-related, it should not be made accessible to all users, but only to authorised users over encrypted channels.

For each session of the Server, this Object also provides an Object representing the session, indicated by <ClientName>. The BrowseName could be derived from the sessionName defined in the CreateSession Service (OPC 10000-4) or some other server-specific mechanisms. It is of the ObjectType SessionDiagnosticsObjectType, as defined in 6.3.5.
retrieved.label: [C7]

source_doc=OPC-10000-5 source_sha256=c8eca3199423cbe5746e6e0aa4782fb990494474668cc9f6b9000cb142aa42bf source_refs=§6.3.3 Table 11 L414-426; §6.3.3 L443-447; §6.3.4 Table 12 L453-463; §6.3.4 L466-471; §6.3.5 Table 13 L477-488; §6.3.5 L491-497; §8.3.1 L2704-2710
以下为从 LLM 整理的 Wiki 正文中选取的完整段落摘录，仅用于解释和导航；规范原文以对应的 Part 5 证据为准。
本页综合 Part 5 §6.3.3–§6.3.5 和 §8.3.1，说明标准服务器诊断树的组织方式：服务器级摘要、Subscription 数组、按 Session 的汇总数组和对象，以及诊断开启/关闭对可用性的影响。它不讨论具体诊断计数器的完整字段（那些在 §12.8–§12.15 中定义），也不讨论 Part 4 的服务调用行为。

`ServerDiagnosticsType` 是 `ServerType.ServerDiagnostics` 的类型，提供 `ServerDiagnosticsSummary`、`SubscriptionDiagnosticsArray`、`SessionsDiagnosticsSummary` 和 `EnabledFlag` 等 Mandatory 成员，以及可选的 `SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsArray`。[§6.3.3 Table 11 L414-L426](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L414-L426)

`SessionsDiagnosticsSummaryType` 为每个 Session 提供一个数组条目和一个 Object；数组存放 `SessionDiagnosticsDataType[]` 和 `SessionSecurityDiagnosticsDataType[]`，Object 的类型是 `SessionDiagnosticsObjectType`。[§6.3.4 Table 12 L453-L463](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L453-L463) 该 Object 在 Table 12 中以 `<ClientName>` 作为 OptionalPlaceholder 的占位 BrowseName；它不是固定 BrowseName，实际 BrowseName 可由 CreateSession 的 `sessionName` 或其他 Server 特定机制派生。[§6.3.4 L466-L471](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L466-L471)

`SessionDiagnosticsObjectType` 再提供单个 Session 的一般诊断、安全诊断、该 Session 的 Subscription 诊断数组，以及可选的 `CurrentRoleIds`。[§6.3.5 Table 13 L477-L488](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L477-L488)

这样不同需求的客户端可以选择批量读取、按对象浏览或按简单字段读取。[§8.3.1 L2704-L2710](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L2704-L2710)

不同用户凭证可能看到不同条目，因此数组长度可能因连接而异；用户被 impersonation 后长度也可能变化。客户端如果订阅固定 index range，可能得到非预期结果。这是 Part 5 对诊断可见性差异的说明。[§8.3.1 L2704-L2710](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L2704-L2710)

- `SessionsDiagnosticsSummaryType.SessionSecurityDiagnosticsArray`：规范建议（should）该安全相关数组不向所有用户开放，而只对经授权用户开放，并通过加密通道访问。[§6.3.4 L466-L471](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L466-L471)
- `SessionDiagnosticsObjectType.SessionSecurityDiagnostics`：规范同样用 should，建议只对经授权用户开放。[§6.3.5 L491-L497](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L491-L497)
- `CurrentRoleIds`：对不是当前 Session 的其他 Session，该信息 shall 只对经授权用户开放，例如具有 Part 18 中 `SecurityAdmin` Role 的用户。[§6.3.5 L491-L497](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L491-L497)

这里 should 与 shall 的强度不同：前两项是建议，`CurrentRoleIds` 的跨 Session 访问限制是 shall。Part 18 的 Role 语义本项目未收录，本页只记录 Part 5 的访问限制。

- `TRUE`：收集；把值设为 `TRUE` 会重置并启用收集。
- `FALSE`：不收集；把值设为 `FALSE` 会禁用收集但不重置已有值。

诊断关闭时，Server 可以对所有静态诊断节点（`EnabledFlag` 除外）返回 `Bad_NodeIdUnknown`；动态诊断节点（例如 Session 节点）不会出现在地址空间中。如果 Server 不支持收集诊断信息，`EnabledFlag` 是只读的。[§6.3.3 L443-L447](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L443-L447)

因此，“类型定义了某个 Mandatory 组件”不等于“运行时一定能读到值”。诊断节点是否出现、是否可读，取决于 `EnabledFlag` 和 Server 的实现状态。

- `ServerStatus` 是服务器状态（启动时间、当前时间、State、构建信息），不是诊断计数器。
- `ServerCapabilities` 是能力声明（Profile、限制、Session 上限等），不是当前使用量。
- `ServerDiagnostics` 是运行时诊断信息（摘要、数组、Session/Subscription 计数等）。

三者都挂在 `Server` 下，但回答不同问题。把 `OperationLimits` 误当成诊断读数，或把 `EnabledFlag` 误当成 Server 是否支持其他服务/能力的开关，都会导致错误理解；`EnabledFlag` 为只读本身可能表明 Server 不支持诊断收集，而不是在声明某项其他能力。[§6.3.3 L443-L447](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L443-L447)

- 服务器级入口：[ServerDiagnosticsType](../entities/serverdiagnosticstype.md)
- Session 汇总：[SessionsDiagnosticsSummaryType](../entities/sessionsdiagnosticssummarytype.md)
- 单个 Session：[SessionDiagnosticsObjectType](../entities/sessiondiagnosticsobjecttype.md)
- 状态与构建：[ServerStatusType](../entities/serverstatustype.md)、[BuildInfoType](../entities/buildinfotype.md)
- 标准 Server 对象：[ServerType](../entities/servertype.md)、[server-information-model](server-information-model.md)
- 事件与审计（与诊断不同）：[events-and-auditing](events-and-auditing.md)

本页不展开 `ServerDiagnosticsSummaryDataType`（§12.9）、`SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsDataType`（§12.8）、`SessionDiagnosticsDataType`（§12.11）、`SessionSecurityDiagnosticsDataType`（§12.12）、`SubscriptionDiagnosticsDataType`（§12.15）的逐字段结构；这些 DataType 尚未单独建页。Part 4 如何维护 Subscription、Part 18 如何评估 Role，本项目未收录。

[C1] NodeIds
4.1 NodeIds

The NodeIds of all Nodes described in this standard are only symbolic names. OPC 10000-6 defines the actual NodeIds.

The symbolic name of each Node defined in this standard is its BrowseName, or, when it is part of another Node, the BrowseName of the other Node, a ".", and the BrowseName of itself. In this case "part of" means that the whole has a HasProperty or HasComponent Reference to its part. Since all Nodes not being part of another Node have a unique name in this standard, the symbolic name is unique. For example, the ServerType defined in 6.3.1 has the symbolic name "ServerType". One of its InstanceDeclarations would be identified as "ServerType.ServerCapabilities". Since this Object is complex, another InstanceDeclaration of the ServerType is "ServerType.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate". The Server Object defined in 8.3.2 is based on the ServerType and has the symbolic name "Server". Therefore, the instance based on the InstanceDeclaration described above has the symbolic name "Server.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate".

The NamespaceIndex for all NodeIds defined in this standard is 0. The namespace for this NamespaceIndex is specified in OPC 10000-3.

Note that this standard not only defines concrete Nodes, but also requires that some Nodes have to be generated, for example one for each Session running on the Server. The NodeIds of those Nodes are server-specific, including the Namespace. However the NamespaceIndex of those Nodes cannot be the NamespaceIndex 0, because they are not defined by the OPC Foundation but generated by the Server.

[C5] §6.3.3 L443-L447
            EnabledFlag identifies whether or not diagnostic information is collected by the Server. It can also be used by a client to enable or disable the collection of diagnostic information of the Server. The following settings of the Boolean value apply: TRUE indicates that the Server collects diagnostic information, and setting the value to TRUE leads to resetting and enabling the collection. FALSE indicates that no diagnostic information is collected, and setting the value to FALSE disables the collection without resetting the diagnostic values.

When diagnostics are turned off, the Server can return Bad_NodeIdUnknown for all static diagnostic Nodes except the EnabledFlag Property. Dynamic diagnostic Nodes (such as the Session Nodes) will not appear in the AddressSpace.

If the collection of diagnostic information is not supported, the EnabledFlag Property will be read only.

[C6] §1 L9-L11
1 Scope

This part of the OPC Unified Architecture defines the Information Model .The Information Model describes standardised Nodes of a Server's AddressSpace. These Nodes are standardised types as well as standardised instances used for diagnostics or as entry points to server-specific Nodes. Thus, the Information Model defines the AddressSpace of an empty OPC UA Server. However, it is not expected that all Servers will provide all of these Nodes.

[C7] §6.3.4 L466-L471
            SessionDiagnosticsArray provides an array with an entry for each session in the Server having general diagnostic information about a session.


            SessionSecurityDiagnosticsArray provides an array with an entry for each active session in the Server having security-related diagnostic information about a session. Since this information is security-related, it should not be made accessible to all users, but only to authorised users over encrypted channels.

For each session of the Server, this Object also provides an Object representing the session, indicated by <ClientName>. The BrowseName could be derived from the sessionName defined in the CreateSession Service (OPC 10000-4) or some other server-specific mechanisms. It is of the ObjectType SessionDiagnosticsObjectType, as defined in 6.3.5.

model.raw_answer:
在 Part 5 中，节点符号名的构成与实际 NodeId 的定义如下：

**符号名构成**
- 本标准中所有节点的 NodeId 只是符号名（symbolic names），实际 NodeId 由 OPC 10000-6 定义 [C1][C2][C4]。
- 每个节点的符号名就是它的 BrowseName；当该节点是另一个节点的一部分时，符号名为“另一节点的 BrowseName + "." + 自身 BrowseName”。这里的“part of”指整体对部分具有 HasProperty 或 HasComponent 引用 [C1][C2][C4]。
- 由于不属于其他节点的节点在本标准中都有唯一名称，符号名是唯一的 [C1][C2][C4]。

**实际 NodeId 由哪里定义**
- 实际 NodeId 由 OPC 10000-6 定义 [C1][C2][C4]。

**NamespaceIndex 的差异**
- 本标准定义的所有 NodeId 的 NamespaceIndex 为 0；该 NamespaceIndex 对应的命名空间由 OPC 10000-3 规定 [C1][C2][C4]。
- 对于标准要求服务器生成的节点（例如每个运行中的 Session 对应一个节点），其 NodeId 是服务器特定的，包括命名空间；但这些节点的 NamespaceIndex 不能是 0，因为它们不是由 OPC Foundation 定义、而是由服务器生成的 [C1][C2][C4]。

（补充：BrowseNames 的文本部分在定义节点的各表中规定，本文档定义的所有 BrowseNames 的 NamespaceIndex 为 0 [C3]。）

question: For namespace-zero Variables, how does ValueRank affect whether ArrayDimensions is supplied, and what must bits 8, 9 and 10 of AccessLevelEx be if that attribute is present?

answer.answer:
For namespace-zero Variables, Table 5 in 5.3 specifies the following [C2][T1][C4]:

**ArrayDimensions and ValueRank**
- If ValueRank does not identify an array of a specific dimension (i.e. ValueRank <= 0), ArrayDimensions can either be set to null or the Attribute can be missing; this behaviour is server-specific [C2][T1][C4].
- If ValueRank specifies an array of a specific dimension (i.e. ValueRank > 0), the ArrayDimensions Attribute shall be specified [C2][T1][C4].

**AccessLevelEx bits 8, 9 and 10**
- If the AccessLevelEx Attribute is provided, bits 8, 9 and 10 shall be set to 0, meaning that read and write operations on an individual Variable are atomic, and arrays can be partly written [C2][T1][C4].

# BuildInfoType

**类型**：VariableType（复杂变量类型，`IsAbstract=False`）  
**父类型**：`BaseDataVariableType`  
**DataType**：`BuildInfo`（ValueRank = -1，标量）  
**规范位置**：OPC 10000-5 §7.7，Table 77；结构定义见 §12.4，Table 230、Table 231

## 用途

`BuildInfoType` 是 `ServerStatusType.BuildInfo` 子变量的类型，用来暴露服务器软件的构建信息。它把 `BuildInfo` 结构中的字段映射为六个 Mandatory 子 Variable，使客户端可以读取软件 URI、厂商、产品名、版本、构建号和构建日期。[§7.7 Table 77 L1939-L1954](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L1939-L1954)

## 重要成员

Table 77 的六个子 Variable 都是 `HasComponent`、`BaseDataVariableType`、`Mandatory`：

| 地址空间成员 | 数据类型 | 对应 `BuildInfo` 字段 |
|---|---|---|
| `ProductUri` | `String` | `productUri` |
| `ManufacturerName` | `String` | `manufacturerName` |
| `ProductName` | `String` | `productName` |
| `SoftwareVersion` | `String` | `softwareVersion` |
| `BuildNumber` | `String` | `buildNumber` |
| `BuildDate` | `UtcTime` | `buildDate` |

answer.answer:
直接使用 ServerRedundancyType（即不通过其子类型）时，RedundancySupport 必须设为 **NONE** [E1][T1][C1]。

RedundantServerArray 可以在会话（Session）期间变化；其元素顺序必须始终与 **ServerUriArray** 变量的数组元素顺序保持一致 [E1][T1][C1]。

question: 直接使用 ServerRedundancyType 而非其子类型时，RedundancySupport 必须取什么值？RedundantServerArray 能否在会话中变化，其元素顺序要与什么保持一致？

answer.answer:
直接使用 ServerRedundancyType（无子类型）时，RedundancySupport 必须设为 **NONE** [E1][T1][C1]。

RedundantServerArray **可以在会话期间变化**；其元素顺序必须始终与 **ServerUriArray** 变量的数组元素顺序一致 [E1][T1][C1]。

The BaseObjectType is used as type definition whenever there is an Object having no more concrete type definitions available. Servers should avoid using this ObjectType and use a more specific type, if possible. This ObjectType is the base ObjectType and all other ObjectTypes shall either directly or indirectly inherit from it. However, it might not be possible for Servers to provide all HasSubtype References from this ObjectType to its subtypes, and therefore it is not required to provide this information.

There are no References specified for this ObjectType. It is formally defined in Table 8.

以下内容为 LLM 整理的 Wiki 正文，仅用于解释和导航；规范原文以对应的 Part 5 证据为准。

# AuditEventType

**类型**：EventType（在地址空间中表示为 ObjectType，`IsAbstract=True`）  
**父类型**：`BaseEventType`  
**规范位置**：OPC 10000-5 §6.4.3，Table 26

## 用途

`AuditEventType` 是审计事件的标准基类。它继承 `BaseEventType` 的全部 Property，并增加审计所需的“谁、何时、对什么动作、结果如何”等字段。它本身是抽象类型；具体审计事件通过其子类型区分连接、Session、证书、节点管理、历史访问、写入和方法调用等场景。[§6.4.2 Table 25 L804-L824](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L804-L824) [§6.4.3 Table 26 L905-L923](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L905-L923)

## 重要成员

Table 26 新增的 Property 如下，均使用 `HasProperty` 和 `PropertyType`：

| 成员 | 数据类型 | 建模规则 | 含义摘要 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ActionTimeStamp` | `UtcTime` | Mandatory | 用户发起动作的时间 |
| `Status` | `Boolean` | Mandatory | 动作是否成功 |
| `ServerId` | `String` | Mandatory | 生成事件的 Server 的唯一标识 |
| `ClientAuditEntryId` | `String` | Mandatory | 客户端提供的可读 AuditEntryId |
| `ClientUserId` | `String` | Mandatory | 发起动作的用户标识 |
| `ClientApplicationUri` | `String` | Optional | 客户端应用的 URI |

这些事件类型对应的 Conformance Units 包括 `Auditing Connections`、`Auditing NodeManagement`、`Auditing History Services`、`Auditing Write` 和 `Auditing Method`。[§6.4.3 Table 26 L905-L923](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L905-L923)

## 语义与边界

`AuditEventType` 继承 `BaseEventType` 的全部 Property，`BaseEventType` 的字段用于描述事件来源。若子类型没有另行规定 `SourceNode`，则该 Property 必须（shall）设为 Server 节点；`SourceName` 通常提供更多来源信息，例如方法调用事件可以是 `"Method/"` 加被调用方法名。[§6.4.3 L924-L928](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L924-L928)

几个容易混淆的字段：

- `ActionTimeStamp` 是**用户发起动作**的时间；`BaseEventType.Time` 是 Server 生成审计事件（记录动作）的时间，两者含义不同。
- `Status=TRUE` 表示请求的动作可以执行；`FALSE` 表示未执行/失败。
- `ServerId` 即使在多个 Server 共用同一 URI 的透明冗余场景中，也应能唯一标识生成事件的 Server。
- `ClientAuditEntryId` 是人类可读的审计条目 ID；若因证书检查失败无法解密，应使用客户端 IP、端口、MAC、DNS 名等可识别信息替代。
- `ClientUserId` 的具体取值依赖身份令牌：UserName 令牌取用户名，X509 令牌取证书 Subject Name，Issued/JWT 令牌按规范规则组合 issuer/subject，Anonymous 令牌则为 null。[§6.4.3 L931-L942](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L931-L942)

规范建议新的 `AuditEventType` 子类型不要增加核心 UA 规范已定义字段之外的额外 Property，以便通用审计客户端用一组核心 EventFields 收集所有相关审计事件。子类型的主要作用是让 `EventType` 可用于排序和分类。[§6.4.3 L924-L928](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L924-L928)

## 相关类型与边界

- 父类型见 [BaseEventType](baseeventtype.md)，综合说明见 [events-and-auditing](../topics/events-and-auditing.md)。
- 具体子类型（如 `AuditSessionEventType`、`AuditCertificateEventType`、`AuditNodeManagementEventType`、`AuditUpdateMethodEventType`）在 §6.4.4–§6.4.27 中定义；本 Wiki 尚未为它们单独建页。
- 身份令牌、Session 和审计配置的服务语义属于 Part 4；Role 语义属于 Part 18；本项目未收录，不展开。
- 本页仅记录 Part 5 的地址空间表示和字段语义，不对审计实现是否满足安全策略作判断。

## 相关页面

- [BaseEventType](baseeventtype.md)：审计事件的父类型。
- [ServerType](servertype.md)：`Auditing` Property 表示 Server 是否生成审计事件。

直接使用 ServerRedundancyType（无子类型）时，RedundancySupport 必须设为 **NONE** [E1][T1][C1]。

question: For AddressSpaceFileType, what should a client do before reading the exported XML file, and which Value Attributes does ExportNamespace include?

answer.answer:
**Before reading the exported XML file:** The client is expected to call the ExportNamespace Method first to update the XML file, and then access the file with the Methods defined in the FileType [C1][C2][T1][C3].

**Which Value Attributes ExportNamespace includes:** The evidence states that Value Attributes are only exported if they represent static configuration information [C1][C2][T1][C3]. It does not enumerate specific Value Attributes, so no further list can be given from the supplied evidence.

Entity: AddressSpaceFileType

Kind: ObjectType

Section: 6.3.12

Supertype: FileType

question: NamespaceMetadataType 的 StaticNodeIdTypes、StaticNumericNodeIdRange 和 StaticStringNodeIdPattern 如何判断静态节点？若某个 IdType 已列入 StaticNodeIdTypes，对应的范围或模式还生效吗？

answer.answer:
根据 [E1] 中 NamespaceMetadataType 的定义，这三个属性都是 Mandatory 的 Property：

- **StaticNodeIdTypes**：数据类型为 `IdType[]`，提供用于静态节点的 IdType 列表。命名空间 AddressSpace 中凡使用该数组中任一 IdType 的节点，都应为静态节点（“All Nodes in the AddressSpace of the namespace using one of the IdTypes in the array shall be static Nodes”）。
- **StaticNumericNodeIdRange**：数据类型为 `NumericRange[]`，提供用于静态节点数值 NodeId 的 NumericRange 列表。
- **StaticStringNodeIdPattern**：数据类型为 `String`，提供按 OPC 10000-4 中 Like 运算符定义的正则表达式，用于筛选静态节点的字符串 NodeId。

关于优先级：[E1] 明确说明，如果 StaticNodeIdTypes 已包含数值 NodeId 的条目，则 StaticNumericNodeIdRange 被忽略；如果 StaticNodeIdTypes 已包含字符串 NodeId 的条目，则 StaticStringNodeIdPattern 被忽略。也就是说，一旦某 IdType 列入 StaticNodeIdTypes，对应的范围或模式不再生效。

[E2] 仅给出 IdType 是 Enumeration 类型及其 EnumStrings 属性，未列出具体枚举值，因此无法从所给证据说明各 IdType 枚举成员的含义。

The BrowseName of instances of this type shall be derived from the represented namespace. This can, for example, be done by using the index of the namespace in the NamespaceArray as NamespaceIndex of the QualifiedName and the namespace URI as name of the QualifiedName.
The NamespaceUri Property contains the namespace represented by an instance of the MetaDataType.
The NamespaceVersion Property provides version information for the namespace. It is intended for display purposes and shall not be used to programmatically identify the latest version. If there is no formal version defined for the namespace this Property shall be set to a null String.
The NamespacePublicationDate Property provides the publication date of the namespace version. This Property value can be used by Clients to determine the latest version if different versions are provided by different Servers when the ModelVersion is not provided. If there is no formal publication date defined for the namespace this Property shall be set to a null DateTime.
The IsNamespaceSubset Property defines whether all Nodes of the namespace are accessible in the Server or only a subset. It is set to FALSE if the full namespace is provided and TRUE if not. If the completeness is unknown then this Property shall be set to TRUE.
Static Nodes are identical for all Attributes in all Servers, including the Value Attribute. For TypeDefinitionNodes, also the InstanceDeclarations shall be identical. That means that for static Nodes the semantic is always the same. Namespaces with static Nodes are for example namespaces defined by standard bodies like the OPC Foundation. This is important information for aggregating Servers. If the namespace is dynamic and used in several Servers the aggregating Server needs to distinguish the namespace for each aggregated Server. The static Nodes of a namespace only need to be handled once, even if they are used by several aggregated Servers.
The StaticNodeIdTypes Property provides a list of IdTypes used for static Nodes. All Nodes in the AddressSpace of the namespace using one of the IdTypes in the array shall be static Nodes.
The StaticNumericNodeIdRange Property provides a list of NumericRanges used for numeric NodeIds of static Nodes. If the StaticNodeIdTypes Property contains an entry for numeric NodeIds then this Property is ignored. 
The StaticStringNodeIdPattern Property provides a regular expression as defined for the Like Operator defined in OPC 10000-4 to filter for string NodeIds of static Nodes. If the StaticNodeIdTypes Property contains an entry for string NodeIds then this Property is ignored.
The Object NamespaceFile contains all Nodes and References of the namespace in an XML file where the Information Model XML Schema is defined in OPC 10000-6. The XML file is provided through an AddressSpaceFileType Object.
The DefaultRolePermissions Property provides the default permissions if a Server supports RolePermissions for the Namespace. A Node in the Namespace overrides this default by adding a RolePermissions Attribute to the Node. If a Server implements a vendor-specific RolePermissions model for a Namespace, it does not add the DefaultRolePermissions Property to the NamespaceMetadata Object.
The DefaultUserRolePermissions Property provides the default user permissions if a Server supports UserRolePermissions for the Namespace. A Node in the Namespace overrides this default by adding a UserRolePermissions Attribute to the Node. If a Server implements a vendor-specific UserRolePermissions model for a Namespace, it does not add the DefaultUserRolePermissions Property to the NamespaceMetadata Object. 
The DefaultAccessRestrictions Property is present if a Server supports AccessRestrictions for the Namespace and provides the defaults. A Node in the Namespace overrides this default by adding a AccessRestrictions Attribute to the Node. If a Server implements a vendor-specific AccessRestriction model for a Namespace, it does not add the DefaultAccessRestrictions Property to the NamespaceMetadata Object. 
The optional ConfigurationVersion Property indicates the current configuration of all Nodes of this Namespace. A Node of this Namespace is identified by having the corresponding NamespaceIndex in the NodeId. A Client can use the ConfigurationVersion Property in conjunction with the Constant Field of the AccessLevelEx Attribute, defined in OPC 10000-3, to optimize the use of Variables which have a constant value.
The optional ModelVersion Property indicates the InformationModel version expressed as a SemanticVersionString allowing programmatic comparisons. All current versions of UANodeSets published by the OPC Foundation include the ModelVersion, however other older UANodeSets may not include ModelVersion.
Programatic comparisions of NamespaceMetadata Objects shall use the following:
When the ModelVersion is specified in both NamespaceMetadata Objects it is used for the comparison and if they are the same then the NamespacePublicationDate is used.
When the ModelVersion Property is specified in only one UANodeSet it is considered newer. The NamespacePublicationDate Property is not used.
When the ModelVersion Property is not specified in either UANodeSet the NamespacePublicationDate Property is used for comparison.

12.18 BitFieldMaskDataType

This simple DataType is a subtype of UInt64 and represents a bit mask up to 32 bits where individual bits can be written without modifying the other bits.

The first 32 bits (least significant bits) of the BitFieldMaskDataType represent the bit mask and the second 32 bits represent the validity of the bits in the bit mask. answer.answer:
**EventQueueOverflowEventType 的含义与来源值**

- **它代表什么**：`EventQueueOverflowEventType` 是 Part 5 §6.4.34 定义的一个 EventType，父类型为 `BaseEventType`，且 `IsAbstract=True`（抽象类型）。它继承 `BaseEventType` 的全部 Property，其语义按 §6.4.2 定义。[E1]
- **生成条件定义在哪里**：所给证据中，[E1] 只给出该类型的定义表（Table 58）与一致性单元，并说明其继承 `BaseEventType` 的 Property；证据中**没有**说明该事件在何种情况下被生成，也没有指出生成条件定义在哪个章节。因此无法依据现有证据回答生成条件的位置；不能据此推断规范中没有该规则。[E1]
- **SourceNode**：该类型事件的 `SourceNode` Property **shall** 被赋值为 **Server Object 的 NodeId**。[E1]
- **SourceName**：该类型事件的 `SourceName` **shall** 为 `"Internal/EventQueueOverflow"`。[E1]

作为背景，`BaseEventType` 将 `SourceNode`（NodeId）与 `SourceName`（String）都定义为 Mandatory Property；一般规则是 `SourceNode` 标识事件来源节点，若事件不针对特定节点则设为 null，且某些子类型可对 `SourceNode` 定义附加规则——`EventQueueOverflowEventType` 正是这样的子类型。[C5][C4][E1]

（说明：所给证据中 [C1]、[C2]、[C3] 涉及 PortableNodeId 与 BitFieldMaskDataType，[C6] 涉及 AuditEventType，[C7] 涉及 Message/Severity，[W1] 为 Wiki 草稿，均不包含本问题的生成条件信息。）

retrieved.title: §6.4.2 L827-L841
retrieved.snippet:
EventId is generated by the Server to uniquely identify a particular Event Notification. The Server is responsible to ensure that each Event has its unique EventId. It may do this, for example, by putting GUIDs into the ByteString. Clients can use the EventId to assist in minimizing or eliminating gaps and overlaps that may occur during a redundancy failover. The EventId shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventId indicating an error.


            EventType describes the specific type of Event. The EventType shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventType indicating an error.

The SourceNode Property identifies the Node that the Event originated from. If the Event is not specific to a Node the NodeId is set to null. Some subtypes of this BaseEventType may define additional rules for the SourceNode Property.


            SourceName provides a description of the source of the Event. This could be the string-part of the DisplayName of the Event source using the default locale of the server, if the Event is specific to a Node, or some server-specific notation.


            Time provides the time the Event occurred. This value is set as close to the event generator as possible. It often comes from the underlying system or device. Once set, intermediate OPC UA Servers shall not alter the value.


            ReceiveTime provides the time the OPC UA Server received the Event from the underlying device of another Server. ReceiveTime is analogous to ServerTimestamp defined in OPC 10000-4, i.e. in the case where the OPC UA Server gets an Event from another OPC UA Server, each Server applies its own ReceiveTime. That implies that a Client may get the same Event, having the same EventId, from different Servers having different values of the ReceiveTime. The ReceiveTime shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the ReceiveTime indicating an error.

retrieved.title: §6.4.3 L924-L928
retrieved.snippet:
This EventType inherits all Properties of the BaseEventType. Their semantic is defined in 6.4.2.

The BaseEventType Properties are used to describe the source of the AuditEvent. SubTypes of AuditEventType may define the Node to assign to the SourceNode Property, if not defined the SourceNode Property shall be set to the Server Node. The SourceName Property for AuditEvent typically provides more information related to the source of the AuditEvents. If the AuditEvent is related to a Method invocation, then typically this Property would be "Method/" concatenated with the name of the invoked Method.

Subtypes of AuditEventType are defined so that the EventTypeId can be used to sort and categorize AuditEvents. It is recommended that new subtypes of AuditEventType do not add additional Properties beyond what is defined in the core UA specifications. This allows a generic audit Client to collect all relevant information using an EventFilter consisting of Event fields from the core AuditEventTypes.

retrieved.title: §6.4.2 L847-L850
retrieved.snippet:
Message provides a human-readable and localizable text description of the Event. The Server may return any appropriate text to describe the Event. A null string is not a valid value; if the Server does not have a description, it shall return the string part of the BrowseName of the Node associated with the Event.


            Severity is an indication of the urgency of the Event. This is also commonly called "priority". Values will range from 1 to 1 000, with 1 being the lowest severity and 1 000 being the highest. 以下为从 LLM 整理的 Wiki 正文中选取的完整段落摘录，仅用于解释和导航；规范原文以对应的 Part 5 证据为准。
本页综合 Part 5 §6.4 和 §8.3.2，说明标准事件类型如何在地址空间中表示、`BaseEventType` 提供哪些公共字段、`AuditEventType` 在此基础上增加什么，以及 Server Object 在事件通知中的位置。审计的“记录什么、保留多久、如何防篡改”等策略不属于 Part 5，本页不展开。

Part 5 规定，标准 EventTypes 在地址空间中表示为 **ObjectTypes**。事件类型的语义已经在 Part 3 中定义；Part 5 的 §6.4 只规定它们在地址空间中的表示。[§6.4.1 L796-L799](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L796-L799)

因此，阅读 Part 5 的 EventType 表时，应把它当作 ObjectType 定义：`IsAbstract`、父类型、`HasProperty` 组件和 ModellingRule 都是地址空间层面的信息。事件实例本身不是这些 ObjectType 的 Object 实例，而是通过事件通知机制传递的字段集合；具体订阅和 EventFilter 行为由 Part 4 定义。

`BaseEventType` 是抽象类型，父类型为 `BaseObjectType`。它的 Mandatory Property 包括 `EventId`、`EventType`、`SourceNode`、`SourceName`、`Time`、`ReceiveTime`、`Message` 和 `Severity`；`LocalTime`、`ConditionClassId`、`ConditionClassName`、`ConditionSubClassId`、`ConditionSubClassName` 为 Optional。[§6.4.2 Table 25 L804-L824](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L804-L824)

1. **身份**：`EventId` 唯一标识一次事件通知，可用于冗余切换时减少缺口/重叠；`EventType` 给出具体事件类型的 NodeId。
2. **来源**：`SourceNode` 指向事件来源节点，无具体来源时为 null；`SourceName` 提供可读描述。
3. **时间**：`Time` 是事件发生时间，应尽量接近事件产生点设置，中间 Server 不得修改；`ReceiveTime` 是当前 Server 收到事件的时间，同一事件经不同 Server 转发时可能不同。[§6.4.2 L827-L841](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L827-L841)
4. **内容**：`Message` 是可本地化文本，不能为 null；`Severity` 为 1–1000，1 最低、1000 最高。[§6.4.2 L847-L850](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L847-L850)

`ConditionClassId` 等四个字段的名称来自 Part 9 的 ConditionClass 概念，后来被推广到一般 Event；Part 9 的完整 Condition/Alarm 语义本项目未收录。

`AuditEventType` 是抽象类型，父类型为 `BaseEventType`，继承后者的全部 Property。它增加的字段包括：

这些字段与 `BaseEventType` 的字段配合：`BaseEventType` 描述事件来源，`AuditEventType` 描述“谁在何时对什么动作、结果如何”。[§6.4.3 Table 26 L905-L923](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L905-L923)

`ActionTimeStamp` 和 `Time` 容易混淆：前者是用户发起动作的时间，后者是 Server 生成审计事件（记录动作）的时间。`Status=TRUE` 表示动作可以执行，`FALSE` 表示未执行/失败。子类型没有另行规定时，`SourceNode` 必须（shall）设为 Server 节点；方法调用审计的 `SourceName` 通常是 `"Method/"` 加方法名。[§6.4.3 L924-L928](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L924-L928)

`ClientUserId` 的取值依赖身份令牌：UserName 取用户名，X509 取证书 Subject Name，Issued/JWT 按 issuer/subject 规则组合，Anonymous 为 null。上述 `ActionTimeStamp`、`Status`、`ClientAuditEntryId`、`ClientUserId` 等字段的语义见 §6.4.3 正文。[§6.4.3 L931-L944](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L931-L944) 身份令牌的服务层语义属于 Part 4，本项目未收录。

这意味着客户端通常可以从 `Server` 这一入口发现事件，而不必先知道具体事件源。事件源节点与 `Server` 之间通过事件源/notifier 引用组织；具体引用类型和订阅行为属于 Part 3/Part 4，本页只记录 Part 5 对 Server Object 的定位。

本项目未收录 Part 3（事件模型）、Part 4（订阅/EventFilter）、Part 9（Alarms and Conditions）和 Part 18（Role-Based Security）。因此本页不解释事件实例如何被订阅、Condition 状态机如何工作，也不对审计合规性作判断。

            EventId is generated by the Server to uniquely identify a particular Event Notification. The Server is responsible to ensure that each Event has its unique EventId. The EventId shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventId indicating an error.


            EventType describes the specific type of Event. The EventType shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventType indicating an error.

The SourceNode Property identifies the Node that the Event originated from. If the Event is not specific to a Node the NodeId is set to null. Some subtypes of this BaseEventType may define additional rules for the SourceNode Property.


            SourceName provides a description of the source of the Event. This could be the string-part of the DisplayName of the Event source using the default locale of the server, if the Event is specific to a Node, or some server-specific notation.


            Time provides the time the Event occurred. This value is set as close to the event generator as possible. It often comes from the underlying system or device. Once set, intermediate OPC UA Servers shall not alter the value.


            ReceiveTime provides the time the OPC UA Server received the Event from the underlying device of another Server. ReceiveTime is analogous to ServerTimestamp defined in OPC 10000-4, i.e. in the case where the OPC UA Server gets an Event from another OPC UA Server, each Server applies its own ReceiveTime. - **它代表什么**：`EventQueueOverflowEventType` 是 Part 5 §6.4.34 定义的一个 EventType，父类型为 `BaseEventType`，且 `IsAbstract=True`（抽象类型）。它继承 `BaseEventType` 的全部 Property，其语义按 §6.4.2 定义。[E1]

question: ProgressEventType 用于报告 Service 调用进度时，Context 应存什么、采用什么类型？Progress 的有效范围和完成值是什么？

answer.answer:
在 Service 调用进度报告场景下，依据 Part 5 的 ProgressEventType 定义：

**Context**
- 内容：包含所报告操作进度的上下文信息；对于 Service 调用，它应为 UInt32，包含该 Service 调用 RequestHeader 的 requestHandle。[E1][C1][T1]
- 类型：Context 属性在类型定义中的 DataType 为 BaseDataType（Mandatory Property）；而 Service 调用场景下其值应为 UInt32。[E1][T1][C3]

**Progress**
- 类型：UInt16（Mandatory Property）。[E1][T1][C3]
- 有效范围：值应在 0 到 100 之间。[E1][C1][T1]
- 完成值：100 表示操作已完成。[E1][C1][T1]

补充：该 EventType 为抽象类型（IsAbstract=True），其 SourceName 在暴露 Service 调用进度时应为 "Service/<Service Name as defined in OPC 10000-4>"。[E1][T1]

1 Scope

This part of the OPC Unified Architecture defines the Information Model .The Information Model describes standardised Nodes of a Server's AddressSpace. These Nodes are standardised types as well as standardised instances used for diagnostics or as entry points to server-specific Nodes. Thus, the Information Model defines the AddressSpace of an empty OPC UA Server. However, it is not expected that all Servers will provide all of these Nodes.

retrieved.title: §1 L9-L11
retrieved.snippet:
1 Scope

This part of the OPC Unified Architecture defines the Information Model .The Information Model describes standardised Nodes of a Server's AddressSpace. These Nodes are standardised types as well as standardised instances used for diagnostics or as entry points to server-specific Nodes. Thus, the Information Model defines the AddressSpace of an empty OPC UA Server. However, it is not expected that all Servers will provide all of these Nodes.
retrieved.label: [C3]

retrieved.title: §6.3.4 L466-L471
retrieved.snippet:
SessionDiagnosticsArray provides an array with an entry for each session in the Server having general diagnostic information about a session.


            SessionSecurityDiagnosticsArray provides an array with an entry for each active session in the Server having security-related diagnostic information about a session. Since this information is security-related, it should not be made accessible to all users, but only to authorised users over encrypted channels.

For each session of the Server, this Object also provides an Object representing the session, indicated by <ClientName>. The BrowseName could be derived from the sessionName defined in the CreateSession Service (OPC 10000-4) or some other server-specific mechanisms. It is of the ObjectType SessionDiagnosticsObjectType, as defined in 6.3.5.
retrieved.label: [C4]

retrieved.title: §4.1 L129-L135
retrieved.snippet:
The NodeIds of all Nodes described in this standard are only symbolic names. OPC 10000-6 defines the actual NodeIds.

The symbolic name of each Node defined in this standard is its BrowseName, or, when it is part of another Node, the BrowseName of the other Node, a ".", and the BrowseName of itself. In this case "part of" means that the whole has a HasProperty or HasComponent Reference to its part. Since all Nodes not being part of another Node have a unique name in this standard, the symbolic name is unique. For example, the ServerType defined in 6.3.1 has the symbolic name "ServerType". One of its InstanceDeclarations would be identified as "ServerType.ServerCapabilities". Since this Object is complex, another InstanceDeclaration of the ServerType is "ServerType.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate". The Server Object defined in 8.3.2 is based on the ServerType and has the symbolic name "Server". Therefore, the instance based on the InstanceDeclaration described above has the symbolic name "Server.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate".

The NamespaceIndex for all NodeIds defined in this standard is 0. The namespace for this NamespaceIndex is specified in OPC 10000-3.

Note that this standard not only defines concrete Nodes, but also requires that some Nodes have to be generated, for example one for each Session running on the Server. The NodeIds of those Nodes are server-specific, including the Namespace. However the NamespaceIndex of those Nodes cannot be the NamespaceIndex 0, because they are not defined by the OPC Foundation but generated by the Server.

根据 Part 5 证据，ProgressEventType 的相关规则如下：

**Context 的内容与类型**
- Context 是 Mandatory 的 Property，其 DataType 在类型定义中为 BaseDataType [E1][T1]。
- 当用于报告 Service 调用进度时，Context 应存放该 Service 调用 RequestHeader 中的 requestHandle，并且应为 UInt32 [E1][C1][C2][T1]。

**Progress 的有效范围与完成值**
- Progress 是 Mandatory 的 Property，DataType 为 UInt16 [E1][T1]。
- Progress 表示已完成百分比，取值应在 0 到 100 之间；其中 100 表示操作已完成 [E1][C1][C2][T1]。

此外，当暴露 Service 调用进度时，SourceName 应为 "Service/<Service Name as defined in OPC 10000-4>" [E1][T1]。

[C1] §1 L9-L11
1 Scope

This part of the OPC Unified Architecture defines the Information Model .The Information Model describes standardised Nodes of a Server's AddressSpace. These Nodes are standardised types as well as standardised instances used for diagnostics or as entry points to server-specific Nodes. Thus, the Information Model defines the AddressSpace of an empty OPC UA Server. However, it is not expected that all Servers will provide all of these Nodes.
[C2] §6.3.3 L429-L435
            ServerDiagnosticsSummary contains diagnostic summary information for the Server, as defined in 12.9.


            SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsArray is an array of diagnostic information per sampling rate as defined in 12.8. There is one entry for each sampling rate currently used by the Server. Its TypeDefinitionNode is the VariableType SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsArrayType, providing a Variable for each entry in the array, as defined in 7.9.

The sampling interval diagnostics are only collected by Servers which use a fixed set of sampling intervals. In these cases, length of the array and the set of contained Variables will be determined by the Server configuration and the NodeId assigned to a given sampling interval diagnostics variable shall not change as long as the Server configuration does not change. A Server may not expose the SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsArray if it does not use fixed sampling rates.

[C3] §6.3.3 L443-L447
            EnabledFlag identifies whether or not diagnostic information is collected by the Server. It can also be used by a client to enable or disable the collection of diagnostic information of the Server. The following settings of the Boolean value apply: TRUE indicates that the Server collects diagnostic information, and setting the value to TRUE leads to resetting and enabling the collection. FALSE indicates that no diagnostic information is collected, and setting the value to FALSE disables the collection without resetting the diagnostic values.

When diagnostics are turned off, the Server can return Bad_NodeIdUnknown for all static diagnostic Nodes except the EnabledFlag Property. Dynamic diagnostic Nodes (such as the Session Nodes) will not appear in the AddressSpace.

If the collection of diagnostic information is not supported, the EnabledFlag Property will be read only.

That means that for static Nodes the semantic is always the same. Namespaces with static Nodes are for example namespaces defined by standard bodies like the OPC Foundation. This is important information for aggregating Servers. If the namespace is dynamic and used in several Servers the aggregating Server needs to distinguish the namespace for each aggregated Server. The static Nodes of a namespace only need to be handled once, even if they are used by several aggregated Servers.
The StaticNodeIdTypes Property provides a list of IdTypes used for static Nodes. All Nodes in the AddressSpace of the namespace using one of the IdTypes in the array shall be static Nodes.
The StaticNumericNodeIdRange Property provides a list of NumericRanges used for numeric NodeIds of static Nodes. If the StaticNodeIdTypes Property contains an entry for numeric NodeIds then this Property is ignored. 
The StaticStringNodeIdPattern Property provides a regular expression as defined for the Like Operator defined in OPC 10000-4 to filter for string NodeIds of static Nodes. If the StaticNodeIdTypes Property contains an entry for string NodeIds then this Property is ignored.
The Object NamespaceFile contains all Nodes and References of the namespace in an XML file where the Information Model XML Schema is defined in OPC 10000-6. The XML file is provided through an AddressSpaceFileType Object.
The DefaultRolePermissions Property provides the default permissions if a Server supports RolePermissions for the Namespace. A Node in the Namespace overrides this default by adding a RolePermissions Attribute to the Node. If a Server implements a vendor-specific RolePermissions model for a Namespace, it does not add the DefaultRolePermissions Property to the NamespaceMetadata Object.
The DefaultUserRolePermissions Property provides the default user permissions if a Server supports UserRolePermissions for the Namespace. A Node in the Namespace overrides this default by adding a UserRolePermissions Attribute to the Node. If a Server implements a vendor-specific UserRolePermissions model for a Namespace, it does not add the DefaultUserRolePermissions Property to the NamespaceMetadata Object. 
The DefaultAccessRestrictions Property is present if a Server supports AccessRestrictions for the Namespace and provides the defaults. A Node in the Namespace overrides this default by adding a AccessRestrictions Attribute to the Node. If a Server implements a vendor-specific AccessRestriction model for a Namespace, it does not add the DefaultAccessRestrictions Property to the NamespaceMetadata Object. 
The optional ConfigurationVersion Property indicates the current configuration of all Nodes of this Namespace. A Node of this Namespace is identified by having the corresponding NamespaceIndex in the NodeId. A Client can use the ConfigurationVersion Property in conjunction with the Constant Field of the AccessLevelEx Attribute, defined in OPC 10000-3, to optimize the use of Variables which have a constant value.
The optional ModelVersion Property indicates the InformationModel version expressed as a SemanticVersionString allowing programmatic comparisons. All current versions of UANodeSets published by the OPC Foundation include the ModelVersion, however other older UANodeSets may not include ModelVersion.
Programatic comparisions of NamespaceMetadata Objects shall use the following:
When the ModelVersion is specified in both NamespaceMetadata Objects it is used for the comparison and if they are the same then the NamespacePublicationDate is used.
When the ModelVersion Property is specified in only one UANodeSet it is considered newer. The NamespacePublicationDate Property is not used.
When the ModelVersion Property is not specified in either UANodeSet the NamespacePublicationDate Property is used for comparison.

[C1] §1 L9-L11
1 Scope

This part of the OPC Unified Architecture defines the Information Model .The Information Model describes standardised Nodes of a Server's AddressSpace. These Nodes are standardised types as well as standardised instances used for diagnostics or as entry points to server-specific Nodes. Thus, the Information Model defines the AddressSpace of an empty OPC UA Server. However, it is not expected that all Servers will provide all of these Nodes.

[C2] §6.3.3 L429-L435
            ServerDiagnosticsSummary contains diagnostic summary information for the Server, as defined in 12.9.


            SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsArray is an array of diagnostic information per sampling rate as defined in 12.8. There is one entry for each sampling rate currently used by the Server. Its TypeDefinitionNode is the VariableType SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsArrayType, providing a Variable for each entry in the array, as defined in 7.9.

The sampling interval diagnostics are only collected by Servers which use a fixed set of sampling intervals. In these cases, length of the array and the set of contained Variables will be determined by the Server configuration and the NodeId assigned to a given sampling interval diagnostics variable shall not change as long as the Server configuration does not change. [C3] §6.3.3 L443-L447
            EnabledFlag identifies whether or not diagnostic information is collected by the Server. It can also be used by a client to enable or disable the collection of diagnostic information of the Server. The following settings of the Boolean value apply: TRUE indicates that the Server collects diagnostic information, and setting the value to TRUE leads to resetting and enabling the collection. FALSE indicates that no diagnostic information is collected, and setting the value to FALSE disables the collection without resetting the diagnostic values.

If the collection of diagnostic information is not supported, the EnabledFlag Property will be read only.

question: For OrderedListType, why is HasOrderedComponent alone insufficient for some clients, what must each ordered Object implement, and what must happen to NodeVersion and model-change events when the order changes?

answer.answer:
**Why HasOrderedComponent alone is insufficient:** The order is provided by the HasOrderedComponent References to the Objects, but not all Clients consider the order returned by the Browse Service (e.g., they may display results in alphabetic order). Therefore, the reference order alone cannot be relied upon by such clients [E2][C1][C2][T1].

**What each ordered Object must implement:** Each `<OrderedObject>` shall implement the `IOrderedObjectType` Interface, which provides the order by a specific Property — the mandatory `NumberInList` Property (DataType Number, PropertyType, Mandatory) [E2][C1][C2][T1][T2]. The order shall be identical to the order managed by the HasOrderedComponent References [T2].

**What must happen to NodeVersion and model-change events when the order changes:** Changes in the order of the List are considered as adding and deleting References. If the order changes, the NodeVersion shall be changed and a GeneralModelChangeEvent shall be issued, indicating that References have been added and deleted [E2][C1][C2][T1]. The NodeVersion is intended to be used in conjunction with the GeneralModelChangeEventType in the way defined in OPC 10000-3, and should be provided if the ordered List can change (e.g., new Objects added or removed), allowing Clients to subscribe to the Property or the GeneralModelChangeEvents instead of polling Browse calls [E2][C1][C2][T1].

Base Info OrderedList
The mandatory Property NumberInList provides the position of the Object in a list, managed by an instance of the OrderedListType. Ideally, the numbering should start with a 0 and have no gaps, but that is not required and Clients shall not assume this. All Objects in the same list shall use the same concrete DataType for the property NumberInList. Two Objects in a list shall never have the same value in this Property. The order shall be identical to the order managed by the HasOrderedComponent References.
Note that due to the nature of a list element, the NumberInList Property is bound to the parent instance of OrderedListType. Objects implementing the Interface can in general not be managed by two instances of OrderedListType at the same time.

Ideally, the numbering should start with a 0 and have no gaps, but that is not required and Clients shall not assume this. All Objects in the same list shall use the same concrete DataType for the property NumberInList. Two Objects in a list shall never have the same value in this Property. The order shall be identical to the order managed by the HasOrderedComponent References.
Note that due to the nature of a list element, the NumberInList Property is bound to the parent instance of OrderedListType. Objects implementing the Interface can in general not be managed by two instances of OrderedListType at the same time.

retrieved.title: §6.1 L201-L203
retrieved.snippet:
6.1 General

Typically, the components of an ObjectType are fixed and can be extended by subtyping. However, since each Object of an ObjectType can be extended with additional components, this standard allows extending the standard ObjectTypes defined in this document with additional components. Thereby, it is possible to express the additional information in the type definition that would already be contained in each Object. Some ObjectTypes already provide entry points for server-specific extensions. However, it is not allowed to restrict the components of the standard ObjectTypes defined in this standard. An example of extending the ObjectTypes is putting the standard Property NodeVersion defined in OPC 10000-3 into the BaseObjectType, stating that each Object of the Server will provide a NodeVersion.
retrieved.label: [C3]

retrieved.title: §4.1 L129-L135
retrieved.snippet:
The NodeIds of all Nodes described in this standard are only symbolic names. OPC 10000-6 defines the actual NodeIds.

The symbolic name of each Node defined in this standard is its BrowseName, or, when it is part of another Node, the BrowseName of the other Node, a ".", and the BrowseName of itself. In this case "part of" means that the whole has a HasProperty or HasComponent Reference to its part. Since all Nodes not being part of another Node have a unique name in this standard, the symbolic name is unique. For example, the ServerType defined in 6.3.1 has the symbolic name "ServerType". One of its InstanceDeclarations would be identified as "ServerType.ServerCapabilities". Since this Object is complex, another InstanceDeclaration of the ServerType is "ServerType.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate". The Server Object defined in 8.3.2 is based on the ServerType and has the symbolic name "Server". Therefore, the instance based on the InstanceDeclaration described above has the symbolic name "Server.ServerCapabilities.MinSupportedSampleRate".

The NamespaceIndex for all NodeIds defined in this standard is 0. The namespace for this NamespaceIndex is specified in OPC 10000-3.

Note that this standard not only defines concrete Nodes, but also requires that some Nodes have to be generated, for example one for each Session running on the Server. The NodeIds of those Nodes are server-specific, including the Namespace. However the NamespaceIndex of those Nodes cannot be the NamespaceIndex 0, because they are not defined by the OPC Foundation but generated by the Server.
retrieved.label: [C4]

retrieved.title: §6.4.2 L827-L841
retrieved.snippet:
EventId is generated by the Server to uniquely identify a particular Event Notification. The Server is responsible to ensure that each Event has its unique EventId. It may do this, for example, by putting GUIDs into the ByteString. Clients can use the EventId to assist in minimizing or eliminating gaps and overlaps that may occur during a redundancy failover. The EventId shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventId indicating an error.


            EventType describes the specific type of Event. The EventType shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventType indicating an error.

The SourceNode Property identifies the Node that the Event originated from. If the Event is not specific to a Node the NodeId is set to null. Some subtypes of this BaseEventType may define additional rules for the SourceNode Property.


            SourceName provides a description of the source of the Event. This could be the string-part of the DisplayName of the Event source using the default locale of the server, if the Event is specific to a Node, or some server-specific notation.


            Time provides the time the Event occurred. This value is set as close to the event generator as possible. It often comes from the underlying system or device. Once set, intermediate OPC UA Servers shall not alter the value.


            ReceiveTime provides the time the OPC UA Server received the Event from the underlying device of another Server. ReceiveTime is analogous to ServerTimestamp defined in OPC 10000-4, i.e. in the case where the OPC UA Server gets an Event from another OPC UA Server, each Server applies its own ReceiveTime. That implies that a Client may get the same Event, having the same EventId, from different Servers having different values of the ReceiveTime. The ReceiveTime shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the ReceiveTime indicating an error.
retrieved.label: [C5]

**What each ordered Object must implement:** Each `<OrderedObject>` shall implement the `IOrderedObjectType` Interface, which provides the order by a specific Property; this Interface includes the mandatory Property `NumberInList` (DataType Number) [E2][C1][C2]. The `HasOrderedComponent` ReferenceType itself is a subtype of `HasComponent` [E1].

**When the order changes:** Changes in the order of the List are considered as adding and deleting References. If the order changes, the `NodeVersion` shall be changed and a `GeneralModelChangeEvent` shall be issued, indicating that References have been added and deleted [E2][C1][C2]. The `NodeVersion` Property (String) is optional in Table 67 and should be provided if the ordered List can change (e.g., new Objects added or removed), allowing Clients to subscribe to the Property or the GeneralModelChangeEvents instead of polling Browse calls [E2][C1][C2].

OptionSetValues 是 OptionSetType 的 Mandatory Property，数据类型为 LocalizedText[]。其每个数组元素包含对应位的可读表示；对于没有具体含义的位，该元素为空的 LocalizedText（empty LocalizedText）。位顺序与数组位置对应：第一位（最低有效位，least significant bit）对应数组第一项，依此类推。[C2][C3][T1]

该 VariableType 的 DataType 必须能够表示位掩码，应为表示有符号或无符号整数的数值 DataType，或 ByteString；例如可以是 BitFieldMaskDataType。[C2][C3]（表 87 中 DataType 属性值为 BaseDataType。[T1]）

7.17 OptionSetType

The OptionSetType VariableType is used to represent a bit mask. Each array element of the OptionSetValues Property contains either the human-readable representation for the corresponding bit used in the option set or an empty LocalizedText for a bit that has no specific meaning. The order of the bits of the bit mask maps to a position of the array, i.e. the first bit (least significant bit) maps to the first entry in the array, etc.

In addition to this VariableType, the DataType OptionSet can alternatively be used to represent a bit mask. As a guideline the DataType would be used when the bit mask is fixed and applies to several Variables. The VariableType would be used when the bit mask is specific for only that Variable.

The DataType of this VariableType shall be capable of representing a bit mask. It shall be either a numeric DataType representing a signed or unsigned integer, or a ByteString. For example, it can be the BitFieldMaskDataType. 

The optional BitMask Property provides the bit mask in an array of Booleans. This allows subscribing to individual entries of the bit mask. The order of the bits of the bit mask points to a position of the array, i.e. the first bit points to the first entry in the array, etc. The VariableType is formally defined in Table 87.

根据 Part 5 证据，OptionSetType 的位掩码与 OptionSetValues 数组的对应关系如下：

**数组与位的对应**
- `OptionSetValues` 是 Mandatory 的 Property，数据类型为 `LocalizedText[]`；`BitMask` 是 Optional 的 Property，数据类型为 `Boolean[]`（[E1]、[T1]、[C1]）。

- OptionSetType 本身的 `DataType` 为 `BaseDataType`，`ValueRank` 为 -1（Scalar），`IsAbstract` 为 False（[E1]、[T1]、[C1]）。证据未进一步列举位掩码值可用的具体数据类型清单。

retrieved.title: §6.1 L201-L203
retrieved.snippet:
6.1 General

Typically, the components of an ObjectType are fixed and can be extended by subtyping. However, since each Object of an ObjectType can be extended with additional components, this standard allows extending the standard ObjectTypes defined in this document with additional components. Thereby, it is possible to express the additional information in the type definition that would already be contained in each Object. Some ObjectTypes already provide entry points for server-specific extensions. However, it is not allowed to restrict the components of the standard ObjectTypes defined in this standard. An example of extending the ObjectTypes is putting the standard Property NodeVersion defined in OPC 10000-3 into the BaseObjectType, stating that each Object of the Server will provide a NodeVersion.
retrieved.label: [C3]

retrieved.title: §6.2 L205-L209
retrieved.snippet:
6.2 BaseObjectType

The BaseObjectType is used as type definition whenever there is an Object having no more concrete type definitions available. Servers should avoid using this ObjectType and use a more specific type, if possible. This ObjectType is the base ObjectType and all other ObjectTypes shall either directly or indirectly inherit from it. However, it might not be possible for Servers to provide all HasSubtype References from this ObjectType to its subtypes, and therefore it is not required to provide this information.

There are no References specified for this ObjectType. It is formally defined in Table 8.
retrieved.label: [C4]

retrieved.title: §6.4.2 L827-L841
retrieved.snippet:
EventId is generated by the Server to uniquely identify a particular Event Notification. The Server is responsible to ensure that each Event has its unique EventId. It may do this, for example, by putting GUIDs into the ByteString. Clients can use the EventId to assist in minimizing or eliminating gaps and overlaps that may occur during a redundancy failover. The EventId shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventId indicating an error.


            EventType describes the specific type of Event. The EventType shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventType indicating an error.

The SourceNode Property identifies the Node that the Event originated from. If the Event is not specific to a Node the NodeId is set to null. Some subtypes of this BaseEventType may define additional rules for the SourceNode Property.


            SourceName provides a description of the source of the Event. This could be the string-part of the DisplayName of the Event source using the default locale of the server, if the Event is specific to a Node, or some server-specific notation.


            Time provides the time the Event occurred. This value is set as close to the event generator as possible. It often comes from the underlying system or device. Once set, intermediate OPC UA Servers shall not alter the value.


            ReceiveTime provides the time the OPC UA Server received the Event from the underlying device of another Server. 以下为从 LLM 整理的 Wiki 正文中选取的完整段落摘录，仅用于解释和导航；规范原文以对应的 Part 5 证据为准。
本页把 Part 5 中与“标准 Server 地址空间”相关的章节串起来：从 Part 5 的范围，到类型根基 `BaseObjectType`，再到标准 `Server` Object 及其 `ServerType` 组件。它回答的是“一个标准 OPC UA Server 在信息模型层面应提供哪些标准入口”，而不是“某个厂商实际实现了哪些功能”。

Part 5 定义 OPC UA Information Model，描述 Server 地址空间中的标准化 Nodes。这些 Nodes 既包括标准化类型，也包括用于诊断或作为服务器特定节点入口的标准化实例。规范因此定义了“一个空 OPC UA Server”的地址空间；但它并不预期每个 Server 都提供所有这些 Nodes。[§1 L9-L11](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L9-L11)

1. **标准地址空间是模板，不是强制全量清单。** 某些节点是由功能、Profile 或一致性单元触发的；未实现某项能力时，相关节点可以不存在。
2. **“标准”不等于“固定实例树”。** Part 5 定义类型和标准入口；本 Part 的 §4.1 给出 NodeId 的符号名与 NamespaceIndex 规则。其他部分本项目未收录，本页不展开。[§4.1 L129-L135](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L129-L135)

`BaseObjectType` 是所有 ObjectType 的直接或间接根类型。它本身没有定义组件；当 Object 没有更具体的类型定义时可以使用它，但 Server 应尽量使用更具体的类型。Server 可能无法提供从它到所有子类型的 `HasSubtype` 引用，因此不要求暴露完整子类型图。[§6.2 L205-L209](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L205-L209) [§6.2 Table 8 L211-L217](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L211-L217)

Part 5 允许通过子类型化扩展标准 ObjectType，也允许在每个 Object 实例上增加组件；但**不允许限制**标准 ObjectType 的组件。规范用 `NodeVersion` 加到 `BaseObjectType` 的例子说明：可以在类型层表达“Server 中的每个 Object 都提供某属性”。[§6.1 L201-L203](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L201-L203)

这意味着标准类型提供的是“最小公共结构 + 可扩展点”，而不是封闭的最终结构。扩展时不能删除或收窄标准组件的建模规则。

`ServerType` 定义标准 Server Object 的能力与服务入口。它的 Mandatory 成员包括 `ServerArray`、`NamespaceArray`、`ServerStatus`、`ServiceLevel`、`Auditing`、`ServerCapabilities`、`ServerDiagnostics`、`VendorServerInfo` 和 `ServerRedundancy`；`UrisVersion`、`EstimatedReturnTime`、`LocalTime`、`Namespaces` 以及若干 Method 是 Optional。[§6.3.1 Table 9 L225-L250](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L225-L250)

Table 9 的原文有些行显示为 `ServerStatus1`、`ServerCapabilities1`、`ServerDiagnostics1`、`ServerRedundancy1`。这些尾随数字是脚注标记，不是 BrowseName。Table 111 只给出 `Server` Object 的 BrowseName、`HasTypeDefinition`（`ServerType`）和一致性单元，不逐项列出成员名。[§8.3.2 Table 111 L2718-L2725](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L2718-L2725) §8.3.2 的附加一致性单元表 Table 112 通过 BrowsePath 引用不带数字的 `ServerStatus`、`ServerCapabilities`、`ServerDiagnostics`、`ServerRedundancy` 等成员名，因此应以这些名称为准。[§8.3.2 Table 112 L2729-L2910](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L2729-L2910)

标准 `Server` Object 是浏览服务器信息的入口，其内容由 `ServerType` 定义，而不是在实例上重新定义一遍；§8.3.2 还规定它是根 notifier：其 `EventNotifier` Attribute 应被设置为提供事件，Server 的所有事件都应能通过订阅该 Object 的事件访问。[§8.3.2 L2714-L2717](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L2714-L2717)

```
Server (Object, TypeDefinition=ServerType)
├─ ServerArray / NamespaceArray / UrisVersion
├─ ServerStatus (ServerStatusType)
│  └─ BuildInfo (BuildInfoType)
├─ ServiceLevel / Auditing / EstimatedReturnTime / LocalTime
├─ ServerCapabilities (ServerCapabilitiesType)
│  ├─ OperationLimits (OperationLimitsType)
│  └─ ModellingRules / AggregateFunctions
├─ ServerDiagnostics (ServerDiagnosticsType)
│  └─ SessionsDiagnosticsSummary (SessionsDiagnosticsSummaryType)
└─ VendorServerInfo / ServerRedundancy / Namespaces
```

- **能力**由 `ServerCapabilities` 表达：Profile、Locale、采样率、连续点、数组/字符串长度、Session/Subscription/MonitoredItem 上限等。它回答“支持什么”。见 [ServerCapabilitiesType](../entities/servercapabilitiestype.md)。
- **状态**由 `ServerStatus` 表达：启动时间、当前时间、ServerState、构建信息、关机倒计时和原因。它回答“现在怎样”。见 [ServerStatusType](../entities/serverstatustype.md) 和 [BuildInfoType](../entities/buildinfotype.md)。
- **诊断**由 `ServerDiagnostics` 表达：服务器摘要、订阅数组、按 Session 的数组和对象、采样间隔诊断。它回答“运行得如何”。见 [ServerDiagnosticsType](../entities/serverdiagnosticstype.md)、[SessionsDiagnosticsSummaryType](../entities/sessionsdiagnosticssummarytype.md) 和 [SessionDiagnosticsObjectType](../entities/sessiondiagnosticsobjecttype.md)。
- **事件**由 EventTypes 表达，`Server` Object 是根 notifier。见 [events-and-auditing](events-and-auditing.md)。

这三类信息不应混用：`OperationLimits` 中的 `MaxNodesPerRead` 不是当前读数，`ServerStatus.State` 不是诊断计数器，`ServerDiagnostics.EnabledFlag` 也不表示 Server 是否支持其他服务/能力。

- **Part 3**：地址空间模型、NodeClass、引用和建模规则的完整语义。
- **Part 4**：服务、Session、Subscription、Read/Write/Browse 等的调用行为。
- **Part 6**：本项目未收录；本页不据此推导实例或编码规则，也不额外断言 NodeId 具体映射的归属。Part 5 自身的 NodeId 规则见 §4.1。
- **Part 7**：Profiles 与一致性单元的组合规则。
- **Part 18**：Role-Based Security 的 Role 和权限语义。

[C3] §6.1 L201-L203
6.1 General

Typically, the components of an ObjectType are fixed and can be extended by subtyping. However, since each Object of an ObjectType can be extended with additional components, this standard allows extending the standard ObjectTypes defined in this document with additional components. Thereby, it is possible to express the additional information in the type definition that would already be contained in each Object. Some ObjectTypes already provide entry points for server-specific extensions. However, it is not allowed to restrict the components of the standard ObjectTypes defined in this standard. An example of extending the ObjectTypes is putting the standard Property NodeVersion defined in OPC 10000-3 into the BaseObjectType, stating that each Object of the Server will provide a NodeVersion.

[C4] §6.2 L205-L209
6.2 BaseObjectType

The BaseObjectType is used as type definition whenever there is an Object having no more concrete type definitions available. Servers should avoid using this ObjectType and use a more specific type, if possible. This ObjectType is the base ObjectType and all other ObjectTypes shall either directly or indirectly inherit from it. However, it might not be possible for Servers to provide all HasSubtype References from this ObjectType to its subtypes, and therefore it is not required to provide this information.

There are no References specified for this ObjectType. It is formally defined in Table 8.

[C5] §6.4.2 L827-L841
            EventId is generated by the Server to uniquely identify a particular Event Notification. The Server is responsible to ensure that each Event has its unique EventId. It may do this, for example, by putting GUIDs into the ByteString. Clients can use the EventId to assist in minimizing or eliminating gaps and overlaps that may occur during a redundancy failover. The EventId shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventId indicating an error.


            EventType describes the specific type of Event. The EventType shall always be returned as value and the Server is not allowed to return a StatusCode for the EventType indicating an error.

The SourceNode Property identifies the Node that the Event originated from. If the Event is not specific to a Node the NodeId is set to null. Some subtypes of this BaseEventType may define additional rules for the SourceNode Property.


            SourceName provides a description of the source of the Event. This could be the string-part of the DisplayName of the Event source using the default locale of the server, if the Event is specific to a Node, or some server-specific notation.


            Time provides the time the Event occurred. This value is set as close to the event generator as possible. It often comes from the underlying system or device. Once set, intermediate OPC UA Servers shall not alter the value.

├─ ServerCapabilities (ServerCapabilitiesType)
│  ├─ OperationLimits (OperationLimitsType)
│  └─ ModellingRules / AggregateFunctions
├─ ServerDiagnostics (ServerDiagnosticsType)
│  └─ SessionsDiagnosticsSummary (SessionsDiagnosticsSummaryType)
└─ VendorServerInfo / ServerRedundancy / Namespaces

- **能力**由 `ServerCapabilities` 表达：Profile、Locale、采样率、连续点、数组/字符串长度、Session/Subscription/MonitoredItem 上限等。它回答“支持什么”。见 [ServerCapabilitiesType](../entities/servercapabilitiestype.md)。
- **状态**由 `ServerStatus` 表达：启动时间、当前时间、ServerState、构建信息、关机倒计时和原因。它回答“现在怎样”。见 [ServerStatusType](../entities/serverstatustype.md) 和 [BuildInfoType](../entities/buildinfotype.md)。

question: Can SelectionListType.Selections change or become empty, how should clients obtain it before use, and does a missing RestrictToList restrict writes to listed values?

answer.answer:
**Can Selections change or become empty?** Yes. The Selections Property may be dynamic, including changes in the length of the array, and it may also be empty, indicating there are currently no valid values which can be written to the Variable [C1][C2].

**How should clients obtain it before use?** Clients should either subscribe to the Selections Property or read it just before use [C1][C2].

**Does a missing RestrictToList restrict writes to listed values?** No. The value may be restricted to only the values defined in the Selections Property by setting the optional RestrictToList Property to True. If RestrictToList is not present or has a value of False, then the value is not restricted to the set defined by the Selections Property [C1][C2]. The table confirms RestrictToList is an optional Property [T1][C3].

7.18 SelectionListType

The SelectionListType VariableType is used for a Variable where the possible values are provided by a set of values.

The Selections Property contains an array of values which represent valid values for this VariableType's value. The Selections Property may be dynamic, including changes in the length of the array. The Selections Property may also be empty indicating there are currently no valid values which can be written to the Variable. The DataType of the Selections Property array shall be of the same DataType as this VariableType. Each array element of the optional SelectionDescriptions Property contains a human-readable representation of the corresponding value in the Selections Property and shall be of the same array size as the Selections Property.

The value of this VariableType may be restricted to only the values defined in the Selections Property by setting the optional RestrictToList Property to a value of True. 7.18 SelectionListType

The SelectionListType VariableType is used for a Variable where the possible values are provided by a set of values.

The Selections Property contains an array of values which represent valid values for this VariableType's value. The Selections Property may be dynamic, including changes in the length of the array. The Selections Property may also be empty indicating there are currently no valid values which can be written to the Variable. Clients should either subscribe to the Selections Property or read it just before use.

The DataType of the Selections Property array shall be of the same DataType as this VariableType. When the SelectionListType is subtyped, the DataType of the Selections Property array of the subtype shall be the same DataType as the subtype. When the SelectionListType is instantiated, the DataType of the Selections Property array of the instance shall be the same as the DataType of the instance.

Each array element of the optional SelectionDescriptions Property contains a human-readable representation of the corresponding value in the Selections Property and shall be of the same array size as the Selections Property.

The value of this VariableType may be restricted to only the values defined in the Selections Property by setting the optional RestrictToList Property to a value of True. If the RestrictToList Property is not present or has a value of False then the value is not restricted to the set defined by the Selections Property.

English summary: The AudioVariableType VariableType defines a Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) media type of the AudibleSound Property. MIME types are defined by other standards such as IETF RFC 2045, IETF RFC 2046 and IETF RFC 2047. The AudioVariableType references the Content-Type that is defined as part of the MIME type and commonly used as a reference to a specific MIME. The top-level media type is used to declare the general type of data, while the subtype specifies a specific format for that type of data. Thus, a media type of "audio /xyz" is a sufficient description for a user agent to determine the data is an audio file, even if the user agent has no knowledge of the specific audio format "xyz".

retrieved.title: 服务器诊断（diagnostics）
retrieved.snippet:
Wiki 摘录 excerpt（Wiki 草稿，AI 整理，非规范原文；完整页面因上下文预算未全部提供） page_id=diagnostics path=wiki/topics/diagnostics.md source_version=1.05.06 status=draft
source_doc=OPC-10000-5 source_sha256=c8eca3199423cbe5746e6e0aa4782fb990494474668cc9f6b9000cb142aa42bf source_refs=§6.3.3 Table 11 L414-426; §6.3.3 L443-447; §6.3.4 Table 12 L453-463; §6.3.4 L466-471; §6.3.5 Table 13 L477-488; §6.3.5 L491-497; §8.3.1 L2704-2710
以下为从 LLM 整理的 Wiki 正文中选取的完整段落摘录，仅用于解释和导航；规范原文以对应的 Part 5 证据为准。
本页综合 Part 5 §6.3.3–§6.3.5 和 §8.3.1，说明标准服务器诊断树的组织方式：服务器级摘要、Subscription 数组、按 Session 的汇总数组和对象，以及诊断开启/关闭对可用性的影响。它不讨论具体诊断计数器的完整字段（那些在 §12.8–§12.15 中定义），也不讨论 Part 4 的服务调用行为。

`ServerDiagnosticsType` 是 `ServerType.ServerDiagnostics` 的类型，提供 `ServerDiagnosticsSummary`、`SubscriptionDiagnosticsArray`、`SessionsDiagnosticsSummary` 和 `EnabledFlag` 等 Mandatory 成员，以及可选的 `SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsArray`。[§6.3.3 Table 11 L414-L426](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L414-L426)

`SessionsDiagnosticsSummaryType` 为每个 Session 提供一个数组条目和一个 Object；数组存放 `SessionDiagnosticsDataType[]` 和 `SessionSecurityDiagnosticsDataType[]`，Object 的类型是 `SessionDiagnosticsObjectType`。[§6.3.4 Table 12 L453-L463](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L453-L463) 该 Object 在 Table 12 中以 `<ClientName>` 作为 OptionalPlaceholder 的占位 BrowseName；它不是固定 BrowseName，实际 BrowseName 可由 CreateSession 的 `sessionName` 或其他 Server 特定机制派生。[§6.3.4 L466-L471](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L466-L471)

`SessionDiagnosticsObjectType` 再提供单个 Session 的一般诊断、安全诊断、该 Session 的 Subscription 诊断数组，以及可选的 `CurrentRoleIds`。[§6.3.5 Table 13 L477-L488](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L477-L488)

- `SessionsDiagnosticsSummary` 有一个按 Session 的数组，适合一次读取或订阅全部条目。
- 同时为每个 Session 提供一个 Object，适合按 Session 浏览详细数据。
- Session Object 内部的复杂 Variable 与数组条目使用相同 DataType，并把同一信息进一步暴露为简单类型的 Variables。
- Subscription 诊断同理：Server 有一个全局数组，每个 Session Object 还有该 Session 的订阅数组。

这样不同需求的客户端可以选择批量读取、按对象浏览或按简单字段读取。[§8.3.1 L2704-L2710](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L2704-L2710)

不同用户凭证可能看到不同条目，因此数组长度可能因连接而异；用户被 impersonation 后长度也可能变化。客户端如果订阅固定 index range，可能得到非预期结果。这是 Part 5 对诊断可见性差异的说明。[§8.3.1 L2704-L2710](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L2704-L2710)

- `SessionsDiagnosticsSummaryType.SessionSecurityDiagnosticsArray`：规范建议（should）该安全相关数组不向所有用户开放，而只对经授权用户开放，并通过加密通道访问。[§6.3.4 L466-L471](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L466-L471)
- `SessionDiagnosticsObjectType.SessionSecurityDiagnostics`：规范同样用 should，建议只对经授权用户开放。[§6.3.5 L491-L497](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L491-L497)
- `CurrentRoleIds`：对不是当前 Session 的其他 Session，该信息 shall 只对经授权用户开放，例如具有 Part 18 中 `SecurityAdmin` Role 的用户。[§6.3.5 L491-L497](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L491-L497)

这里 should 与 shall 的强度不同：前两项是建议，`CurrentRoleIds` 的跨 Session 访问限制是 shall。Part 18 的 Role 语义本项目未收录，本页只记录 Part 5 的访问限制。

- `TRUE`：收集；把值设为 `TRUE` 会重置并启用收集。
- `FALSE`：不收集；把值设为 `FALSE` 会禁用收集但不重置已有值。

诊断关闭时，Server 可以对所有静态诊断节点（`EnabledFlag` 除外）返回 `Bad_NodeIdUnknown`；动态诊断节点（例如 Session 节点）不会出现在地址空间中。如果 Server 不支持收集诊断信息，`EnabledFlag` 是只读的。[§6.3.3 L443-L447](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L443-L447)

因此，“类型定义了某个 Mandatory 组件”不等于“运行时一定能读到值”。诊断节点是否出现、是否可读，取决于 `EnabledFlag` 和 Server 的实现状态。

- `ServerStatus` 是服务器状态（启动时间、当前时间、State、构建信息），不是诊断计数器。
- `ServerCapabilities` 是能力声明（Profile、限制、Session 上限等），不是当前使用量。
- `ServerDiagnostics` 是运行时诊断信息（摘要、数组、Session/Subscription 计数等）。

三者都挂在 `Server` 下，但回答不同问题。把 `OperationLimits` 误当成诊断读数，或把 `EnabledFlag` 误当成 Server 是否支持其他服务/能力的开关，都会导致错误理解；`EnabledFlag` 为只读本身可能表明 Server 不支持诊断收集，而不是在声明某项其他能力。[§6.3.3 L443-L447](../../source/OPC-10000-5-v1.05.06.md#L443-L447)

本页不展开 `ServerDiagnosticsSummaryDataType`（§12.9）、`SamplingIntervalDiagnosticsDataType`（§12.8）、`SessionDiagnosticsDataType`（§12.11）、`SessionSecurityDiagnosticsDataType`（§12.12）、`SubscriptionDiagnosticsDataType`（§12.15）的逐字段结构；这些 DataType 尚未单独建页。Part 4 如何维护 Subscription、Part 18 如何评估 Role，本项目未收录。

[C1] AudioVariableType
7.19 AudioVariableType

The AudioVariableType VariableType defines a Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) media type of the AudibleSound Property. MIME types are defined by other standards such as IETF RFC 2045, IETF RFC 2046 and IETF RFC 2047. The AudioVariableType references the Content-Type that is defined as part of the MIME type and commonly used as a reference to a specific MIME. The top-level media type is used to declare the general type of data, while the subtype specifies a specific format for that type of data. Thus, a media type of "audio /xyz" is a sufficient description for a user agent to determine the data is an audio file, even if the user agent has no knowledge of the specific audio format "xyz".
